purpose: Extend the common-operation regression guardrail to the numeric routine families added in 0.4.

revision.reason: The prior report covered only ten inherited ufunc/reduction workloads. This preregistration adds representative 0.4 creation, shape, joining, statistics, selection, ordering/search, binning, set, and numeric-convenience calls; it does not change the separate three application workflows or their thresholds.
revision.baseline_meaning: First complete 0.4 numeric-routine implementation, before later profile-guided optimization commits.

measurement.worker_processes: A fresh process for every workload and input size.
measurement.timing: Median wall-clock nanoseconds per eager Raptors API call; tracemalloc is disabled during every timed sample.
measurement.python_memory: Separate one-call tracemalloc peak after timing; Python allocations only.
measurement.process_memory: Separate process high-water RSS increment after imports and input preparation; allocator and page-size effects apply.
measurement.correctness: Compare shape and dtype and all values up to 4096 output elements; compare shape, dtype, and first/middle/last values for larger outputs. Full representative results remain covered by the differential suite.

regression_threshold.explanation: A cell above 1.10 requires a reviewed, accepted explanation; otherwise the common-operation guardrail remains open. This is a Raptors-to-Raptors regression check, not a NumPy speed target.

workloads.name: arange_creation
workloads.input: No input array; generate n consecutive int32 values.
workloads.output: One int32 vector of length n.

workloads.name: reshape_transpose
workloads.input: C-contiguous int32 values 0 through n-1; each preregistered n is a perfect square.

workloads.name: concatenate
workloads.input: Two C-contiguous int32 vectors of length n with distinct deterministic modular sequences.

workloads.name: take
workloads.input: C-contiguous int32 values 0 through n-1; int64 indices 0, 2, 4, ... .
workloads.output: Selected int32 values, approximately n/2 elements.

workloads.name: where
workloads.input: A parity boolean mask and two deterministic C-contiguous float32 vectors of length n.
workloads.output: One float32 vector of length n.

workloads.name: sort
workloads.output: One sorted int32 vector of length n.

workloads.name: searchsorted
workloads.input: A sorted int32 vector 0 through n-1 and int32 queries (i*37)%n for i in range(0,n,11).
